[verified] CH_CONTRACT_MONTHS (contract_months: 144.0 -> 120.0): GreenMetro stays L1; its lifetime NPV moves -50.20 Cr (-9.1%); margin 13.61 -> 8.65 Cr. [finding] CH_AWARD_METRIC (award_metric: lifetime escalated NPV -> year_one): tender metric (first 12 months of operation): L1 = MetroLink (MetroLink 79.92 Cr, GreenMetro 81.95 Cr, UrbanDrive 85.28 Cr); DIFFERENT from the lifetime winner GreenMetro. [verified] all_assumptions (evaluation basis: company policy -> buyer evaluation rules): GreenMetro stays L1; its lifetime NPV moves +22.33 Cr (+4.1%); margin 13.61 -> 21.68 Cr. Verdict: OVERTURNED (contested); final winner MetroLink.

narrative.headline: The audit verdict is overturned with MetroLink as the final winner because the contested rate discrepancy changes the award outcome.
findings: Regarding greenmetro_rate_words, the baseline is contested because the award flips to MetroLink when the rate changes.
Regarding CH_DISCOUNT_RATE, the verified engine proved GreenMetro stays L1 and its lifetime NPV and margin increase.
Regarding CH_INDEX_WINDOW, the verified engine proved GreenMetro stays L1 and its lifetime NPV and margin increase.
Regarding CH_CONTRACT_MONTHS, the verified engine proved GreenMetro stays L1 and its lifetime NPV and margin decrease.
Regarding CH_AWARD_METRIC, the finding shows the tender metric for the first twelve months of operation names MetroLink as L1, which is different from the lifetime winner GreenMetro.
Regarding all_assumptions, the verified engine proved GreenMetro stays L1 and its lifetime NPV and margin increase under buyer evaluation rules.
narrative.recommendation: The buyer must formally clarify and confirm the correct rate wording and the intended award metric before signing the contract. Resolving these ambiguities will ensure the final award aligns with official policy and undisputed financial figures.
